name: Use depth of field deliberately
short_description: Use depth of field deliberately once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can use depth of field deliberately in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Use depth of field deliberately means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Use depth of field deliberately in a fresh real-life scenario.
